title: 7 Easy Ways to Include Blueberries in Your Daily Routine
metaDescription: Practical ideas to eat blueberries every day: at breakfast, in the lunchbox, smoothies, salads and desserts. Plus how to keep them fresh longer.
excerpt: From breakfast to dinner: simple ideas so blueberries become part of your day without any hassle.
imageAlt: Several simple preparations with fresh blueberries: smoothie, yogurt bowl, spinach salad and a bowl of blueberries

blocks.text: Eating better doesn’t have to be complicated. Here are seven practical ways to enjoy your Fresh Pick blueberries throughout the day.
Add them to oatmeal, yogurt or pancakes. A handful is enough to bring color and flavor to the first meal of the day.
Blueberries, yogurt and oats: in 5 minutes you have a filling, colorful smoothie.
They are one of the few snacks that need no preparation: wash them, dry them and take them in a small container.
They pair very well with spinach, farmer’s cheese and walnuts. The sweet-and-tart touch balances savory flavors.
Muddled with mint and sparkling water, they are a natural alternative to soda.
A frozen yogurt with blueberries satisfies a sweet craving with simple ingredients.
7. In preparations for the whole week
A homemade chia jam lasts up to a week in the fridge and works for toast, yogurt or desserts.
How to keep them fresh longer

items: Keep them in the fridge, in their original box, unwashed.
Wash them only right before eating them: the natural bloom protects them.
If you won’t eat them within a few days, freeze them spread on a tray and then move them to a bag.
